regime_context: Detector shows broad rotation (56% eligible) with no single dominant narrative, led by Base Metals & Copper ahead of Oil & Gas Producers by a thin margin. The absolute-trend gate is validated for risk control on this market (gate_helps true), but the top three themes all carry mean-revert hurst tags and only modest breadth, so this is best read as a commodity-led regime with staying-power discipline, not a trend-confirmation signal.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (rank 3, XGD.TO) is the closest challenger to the commodity complex but has weak breadth (0.4) and a mean-revert tag — watching for its breadth to exceed 0.5 AND score to close the gap on rank 2 before treating it as a confirmed leadership handoff rather than a reflexive bounce.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Rank-1 theme with strongest score and breadth (0.556), eligible under the absolute-trend gate. The gate's validated drawdown-control property supports taking the trend leg rather than fighting the leader, even though the hurst_tag is mean-revert and cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0. This is a direction lean on the prevailing leadership, not a return forecast.
evidence: durability_bar 0.5, breadth 0.556 (moderate, below the 0.6+ trend-health zone but best of the leaders)
absolute-trend gate validated for drawdown control on this market
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst tag and moderate durability mean this leadership is not sticky; copper is a global-growth proxy and can unwind fast on macro disappointment without any Canada-specific signal changing.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO lags the S&P/TSX by 3% over any rolling 10 sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Rank-2 with score 1.545, highest breadth among the leaders (0.571), and the best durability_bar (0.61), suggesting a cohesive energy tape. Eligible under the trend gate, which supports holding the leg for its drawdown-control property rather than any expected return edge.
theses.dissent: Energy is a mean-reverting beta sector tied to crude; a single OPEC or demand shock can reverse the entire theme faster than the breadth signal can adapt, and the hurst_tag is mixed.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO breaks below its 30-day rolling midpoint while XBM.TO stays above its own

Avoid is not a sell or fade — it is a deliberate non-participation given the crowding caution applies as a size-down/skip signal only, and the theme is not supporting a directional case anyway.

theses.dissent: Crowding flags can mark attention spikes rather than tops, and a crowded theme can keep running if flows persist; avoidance could mean missing a legitimate risk-on extension.
